newsitem.title: UK: Williams says current performance pleasing.
newsitem.headline: Williams says current performance pleasing.

text.p: British security firm Williams Holdings Plc said on Wednesday the year has started well and the underlying performance of the business has been "pleasing".
However, the group noted that "currency translation has reduced sterling growth rate comparisons".

Demand has remained generally firm for its worldwide fire protection and security businesses, while the home improvements performance was "encouraging" with continued strength seen in North America and some improvement seen in the UK and Europe.

Williams completed the acquisition of Chubb Security at the end of April. Having started an integration programme, it said: "We have been pleased that our findings have confirmed our original judgement on both the quality and potential of the businesses".
The company said it was now established as a world market leader in fire protection and security and has a "commanding" position for home improvement products.
"Our immediate business prospects, based on current order books, continue to be sound," it added.
